news.headline: Crude oil eases: WTI -0.75%, Brent -0.54%
news.what_happened: WTI at $95.78 and Brent at $105.35, both lower, though still at elevated levels.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude reduces jet fuel and petro-derived input costs for airlines and paints; negative for upstream oil.

news.headline: Asia risk-on: Nikkei +1.67%, Hang Seng +0.93%
news.what_happened: Asian equities rallied; Nifty closed +1.21% at 22,997 previously.
news.why_it_matters: Supportive regional sentiment for Indian open, though part of the move may already be priced in.

news.headline: US 10Y yield falls ~2% to 5.09%; S&P +0.33%
news.what_happened: US yields eased from 5.19%; S&P 500 closed marginally higher at 7,744.
news.why_it_matters: Easing yields help EM flows and rate-sensitive sectors, but yields remain very high.

sector_outlook.reason: Supportive global cues but Nifty already +1.2% yesterday

picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline opex; further crude easing is a direct margin tailwind.
Crude derivatives are 40-50% of paint raw material cost; lower crude eases input cost pressure.
